notes:
Primary source: Crown Audio official product page (crownaudio.com/en-US/products/dci-4-1250n) for headline specs (AC 100-240V, 20A IEC inlet, 2RU/3.5in height, 30lb/13.6kg, output power at 2/4/8/16 ohm and 70V/100V). Detailed rear-panel connector layout (Euroblock input/output pin counts, BLU link In/Out ports, Ethernet vs BLU link distinction, GPIO as 6-position RJ-11, AUX 3-pin connector) confirmed from Crown/HARMAN's official "DCi Series - Network Input Models Operation Manual" (PDF, hosted at avc-group.com/fullcompass.com), which explicitly lists back-panel features for the group "2|300N, 2|600N, 2|1250N, 4|300N, 4|600N, 4|1250N, 8|300N, 8|600N" and separately confirms the 4|1250N (along with 8|600N) uses the 20A IEC inlet variant (vs standard IEC on lower-power siblings) and a resettable breaker instead of a fuse.

Caveats: (1) GPIO port is physically a 6-position RJ-11 connector; "rj45" was used as the closest available connector id since rj11 is not in the allowed list — treat as a modular jack, not true RJ45 Ethernet. (2) Ethernet port speed (10/100 vs other) is not stated in any source found, so no grade was set. (3) BLU link ports use RJ45-style Cat5e jacks but carry a proprietary digital-audio-only protocol (not IP Ethernet) — modeled as bidirectional RJ45 with a note; no bandwidth grade applied since BLU link is not in the RJ45 eth-* grading scale's intended sense and the manual does not express it as 100M/1G/etc. (4) AC inlet is described in the manual/spec sheet only as "20A IEC" without an explicit C19/C20 callout; iec-c19 was chosen as the closest listed id for a 20A-rated IEC inlet (standard IEC C13/C14 is rated ≤15A). (5) Input/output Euroblock connector exact pin spacing (3.81mm, 6-pin) confirmed via a Crown parts reference in secondary sources (AVS Forum/Crown parts number 5024623) rather than the primary manual text itself. (6) The manual's back-panel diagram groups DCi 4|1250N with several other wattage variants (2|300N through 8|600N) sharing identical rear-panel connector layout differing only in the AC inlet current rating: 4|1250N and 8|600N get the 20A IEC inlet; the rest use a standard-rated IEC inlet.

ports.name: Input 1/2
ports.note: 6-pin plug-in terminal block, balanced high-impedance analog input serving channel pair 1/2 (odd channel wired for bridge mode)

ports.name: Input 3/4
ports.note: 6-pin plug-in terminal block, balanced high-impedance analog input serving channel pair 3/4

ports.name: Output 1/2
ports.note: Four-pole touch-proof terminal strip, accepts up to 10 AWG wire or terminal forks, speaker output for channel pair 1/2 (2/4/8/16 ohm or 70V/100V selectable)

ports.name: Output 3/4
ports.note: Four-pole touch-proof terminal strip, accepts up to 10 AWG wire or terminal forks, speaker output for channel pair 3/4

ports.name: BLU link In
ports.note: Cat5e digital audio transport port (HARMAN BLU link ring), up to 256ch @48kHz/128ch @96kHz, 24-bit; dedicated audio bus, not general Ethernet

ports.name: BLU link Out
ports.note: Cat5e digital audio transport port (HARMAN BLU link ring); pairs with BLU link In to complete the ring

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Cat5e control/monitoring port using HiQnet protocol over TCP/IP with Audio Architect software; link speed not stated in manufacturer documentation, grade omitted

ports.name: GPIO
ports.note: Physically a 6-position RJ-11 connector (not RJ-45; closest allowed id used). 2 analog/binary inputs + 2 binary outputs, 0-3.3V logic, for preset recall, gain/mute control, fault reporting

ports.name: AUX
ports.note: 3-pin plug-in terminal connector for remote SLEEP control and AMP STATUS monitoring; shares ground with GPIO pin 6

ports.name: AC Power Inlet
ports.note: 20A IEC power inlet (device-side C20 receptacle mating a C19 plug), 100-240V~ 50/60Hz, resettable circuit breaker (this DCi4|1250N and DCi8|600N use the 20A variant vs. standard 15A IEC on other DCi-N models)
